Good news! Yunyaoyun Aerospace has been selected as one of the "Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Typical Cases of Innovation Application of Beidou Spatial Information"
On July 3, 2026, the "Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Beidou Spatial Intelligence International Cooperation Development Forum" of the 2026 Global Digital Economy Conference was grandly held

On July 3, 2026, the "Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Beidou Spatial Intelligence International Cooperation Development Forum" of the 2026 Global Digital Economy Conference was grandly held in the Wan Chun Hall of the Zhongguancun National Independent Innovation Demonstration Zone Exhibition Center in Beijing. At the forum, the three regions of Beijing, Tianjin and Hebei jointly released the "Typical Cases of Beidou Spatial Information Innovation Application in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Region". The case of "Innovative Application of Beidou-Based Sky-Ground Integrated Real-Time Atmospheric Precipitable Water Vapor Monitoring in Major Event Security" submitted by Tianjin Yunyao Aerospace Technology Co., Ltd. was successfully selected. The representatives of the core business maintenance and upgrade project team of Yunyao Aerospace stepped onto the stage to receive the award, and together with government leaders, academicians, experts from the three regions of Beijing, Tianjin and Hebei, as well as over a hundred industry guests, witnessed this moment.

![](/media/news/ryjxImg45_260709094458A403.webp)

This case collection is an important measure taken by the economic and information technology (industrial and information technology) departments of Beijing, Tianjin and Hebei to implement the national strategy for large-scale application of Beidou and to fulfill the "Initiative for Promoting the Development of Beidou Spatial Information Industry in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Region". The selected cases cover multiple key areas such as transportation, energy, emergency response and meteorology. The inclusion of Yunyao Aerospace indicates that the company's technical strength and industrialization achievements in the field of Beidou spatial information services have been highly recognized by the government departments and industry experts in Beijing, Tianjin and Hebei.

![](/media/news/ryjxImg46_260709094544A404.webp)

Since the Beidou Forum was established at the Global Digital Economy Conference, this year's event has been upgraded for the first time with the name "International Cooperation on Spatial Intelligence", highlighting the pivotal role of Beidou's spatial information services in the national strategic regional coordination and the digital economy landscape. Yunyao Aerospace, as a representative enterprise of Tianjin's commercial aerospace industry, brings with it the largest capacity commercial occultation detection constellation composed of nearly 50 meteorological satellites. With the integrated sensing link of "space-based Beidou occultation + ground-based Beidou CORS", it provides high-precision and high-efficiency atmospheric and water vapor monitoring services for the coordinated development of the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, becoming a typical example of commercial meteorological services empowering the regional digital economy.

面向全球气象监测与SAR能力建设 云遥宇航与航升卫星达成战略合作
云遥宇航与航升卫星达成战略合作 随着商业航天进入规模化组网发展的新阶段，产业链协同创新正成为推动商业卫星高质量发展的重要支撑。从单星研制迈向星座建设，从单一能力迈向多载荷融合，如何构建高效率、高可靠的卫星研制与批量交付体

### 云遥宇航与航升卫星达成战略合作
随着商业航天进入规模化组网发展的新阶段，产业链协同创新正成为推动商业卫星高质量发展的重要支撑。从单星研制迈向星座建设，从单一能力迈向多载荷融合，如何构建高效率、高可靠的卫星研制与批量交付体系，成为商业航天发展的重要课题。

围绕全球气象监测网络建设和SAR能力布局，近日，天津云遥宇航科技有限公司（以下简称“云遥宇航”）与湖南航升卫星科技有限公司（以下简称“航升卫星”）在天津签署战略合作框架协议。双方将围绕全球SAR星座建设、新一代气象监测星座建设、卫星平台与载荷一体化适配等方向开展深度合作，进一步整合产业链优势资源，推进关键技术协同创新，共同提升商业星座建设能力。

![](/media/news/ppdtImg18_260709085016A395.webp)

### 从全球气象监测走向多源遥感能力建设

近年来，云遥宇航持续推进商业气象卫星建设，不断完善覆盖全球的气象监测网络。

公司核心工程——云遥气象星座，规划部署90颗掩星探测卫星和24颗综合探测卫星。截至目前，星座已成功发射47颗卫星，系列卫星已进入中国气象局综合气象观测系统并实现业务运行，每日产出数万条专业气象数据产品，为气象服务、防灾减灾、新能源功率预测、电力交易、远洋船舶导航等领域提供持续稳定的数据服务支撑。

在持续完善气象数据能力的同时，云遥宇航近年来不断拓展SAR技术布局，围绕SAR载荷开展持续研发，经过多年的技术积累，已形成覆盖系统设计仿真、载荷研发、总装总测等环节的研发能力，为构建多源遥感数据服务体系奠定了技术基础。

### 聚焦能力协同 提升星座建设效率

随着全球气象监测星座持续推进以及SAR业务不断拓展，云遥宇航对于卫星平台工程化、批量制造能力以及平台与载荷协同设计能力提出了更高要求。

基于双方在产业链不同环节形成的能力优势，此次合作将进一步推动卫星平台与载荷协同设计、整星研制和规模化制造能力建设，为商业星座建设提供更加高效的技术支撑。

![](/media/news/ppdtImg19_260709085131A396.webp)

### 围绕两大方向推进合作落地

双方将围绕全球SAR星座建设和新一代全球气象监测星座建设开展合作。

在SAR方向，双方将协同推进SAR载荷与大功率卫星平台一体化研制，计划于2027年完成首颗SAR卫星发射及在轨验证，2028年完成不少于3颗SAR卫星研制发射。

在新一代全球气象监测星座建设方面，双方计划于2026年完成不少于3颗卫星研制，2027年完成不少于10颗卫星研制发射，持续提升全球气象监测网络建设能力。

### 发挥产业链优势 推动协同创新

签约仪式上，**云遥宇航表示，航升卫星在卫星平台设计和整星集成方面具备成熟的工程化能力，可有效支撑云遥气象星座高密度组网发射需求。通过平台与载荷的一体化适配，将进一步提升卫星研制效率和批量化生产能力，共同赋能商业星座规模化建设和产业创新发展。**

航升卫星表示，**云遥宇航持续稳定的星座组网发射任务，将为公司卫星联合研制、批量交付、大功率平台在轨验证以及SAR卫星整星研制提供重要应用场景，加速新一代卫星平台技术迭代优化和产业化进程**

### 共同探索商业航天产业新空间

当前，商业航天正从单点技术突破迈向产业链协同发展新阶段。平台、载荷、数据、应用等环节之间的深度协作，正在成为推动产业规模化发展的重要动力。

此次战略合作，是云遥宇航持续推进全球气象监测能力建设和SAR能力布局的重要一步。未来，双方将继续围绕卫星技术创新、星座建设和产业协同开展深入合作，积极服务国家"十五五"时期商业航天发展需求，推动国产商业卫星技术持续进步，加快商业SAR卫星和全球气象监测卫星规模化建设，为新能源、航海、低空经济等领域提供更加丰富、高效的空间信息服务，助力我国商业航天产业高质量发展。

### Yunyao Aerospace and Hangsheng Satellite have established a strategic partnership.

As commercial spaceflight enters a new stage of large-scale network development, collaborative innovation within the industrial chain is becoming a crucial support for promoting the high-quality development of commercial satellites. Moving from the development of individual satellites to the construction of constellations, and from a single capability to multi-load integration, how to establish an efficient and reliable satellite development and batch delivery system has become an important issue for the development of commercial spaceflight. 

In recent days, Tianjin Yunyao Aerospace Technology Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as "Yunyao Aerospace") and Hunan Hangsheng Satellite Technology Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as "Hangsheng Satellite") signed a strategic cooperation framework agreement in Tianjin. The two parties will carry out in-depth cooperation in directions such as global SAR constellation construction, new-generation meteorological monitoring constellation construction, and integration of satellite platforms and payloads, further integrating the advantageous resources of the industrial chain, promoting collaborative innovation in key technologies, and jointly enhancing the construction capabilities of commercial constellations.

![](/media/news/ppdtImg18_260709085417A397.webp)

### From global meteorological monitoring to the construction of multi-source remote sensing capabilities

In recent years, Yunyao Aerospace has been continuously advancing the construction of commercial meteorological satellites and continuously improving the global meteorological monitoring network.

The core project of the company - Yunyao Meteorological Constellation - plans to deploy 90 occultation detection satellites and 24 comprehensive detection satellites. As of now, the constellation has successfully launched 47 satellites, and the series of satellites have entered the China Meteorological Administration's comprehensive meteorological observation system and achieved operational use. They produce tens of thousands of professional meteorological data products every day, providing continuous and stable data service support for meteorological services, disaster prevention and mitigation, power generation prediction for new energy, power trading, navigation of ocean-going vessels, and other fields.

While continuously improving the meteorological data capabilities, Yunyao Aerospace has been expanding its SAR technology layout in recent years. It has carried out continuous research and development around SAR payloads. After years of technological accumulation, it has formed a research and development capability covering system design simulation, payload development, assembly and testing, etc., laying a technical foundation for building a multi-source remote sensing data service system.

### Focusing on collaborative capabilities to enhance the efficiency of constellation construction

With the continuous advancement of the global meteorological monitoring constellation and the continuous expansion of SAR business, Cloud Remote Space Agency has raised higher requirements for the engineeringization and batch manufacturing capabilities of satellite platforms, as well as the collaborative design capabilities between the platform and payloads.

Based on the respective capability advantages formed by both parties in different links of the industrial chain, this cooperation will further promote the collaborative design of satellite platforms and payloads, the integrated satellite development and the construction of large-scale manufacturing capabilities, providing more efficient technical support for the construction of commercial constellations.

![](/media/news/ppdtImg19_260709085611A398.webp)

### Push forward the implementation of cooperation in two major directions

The two sides will carry out cooperation on the construction of the global SAR constellation and the new generation of global meteorological monitoring constellation.

In the SAR field, the two sides will jointly promote the integrated research and development of SAR payloads and high-power satellite platforms. They plan to complete the launch and in-orbit verification of the first SAR satellite in 2027, and complete the research and launch of no less than 3 SAR satellites in 2028.

In the construction of the new generation of global meteorological monitoring constellation, the two sides plan to complete the research and development of no less than 3 satellites in 2026, and complete the research and launch of no less than 10 satellites in 2027, continuously enhancing the construction capacity of the global meteorological monitoring network.

### Utilize the advantages of the industrial chain and promote collaborative innovation

At the signing ceremony,** Yun Yao Aerospace stated that the Hang Sheng satellite has mature engineering capabilities in satellite platform design and overall satellite integration, which can effectively support the high-density networking launch requirements of the Yun Yao meteorological constellation. Through the integration and adaptation of the platform and payloads, it will further enhance the satellite development efficiency and batch production capacity, and jointly empower the large-scale construction of commercial constellations and the innovation of industrial development.**

Hang Sheng satellite stated that **the continuous and stable constellation networking launch tasks of Yun Yao Aerospace will provide important application scenarios for the company's satellite joint research and development, batch delivery, large-power platform in-orbit verification, and SAR satellite overall satellite research and development, accelerating the technological iteration and industrialization process of the new-generation satellite platform.**

### Jointly explore new frontiers in the commercial aerospace industry

Currently, commercial aerospace is moving from single technological breakthroughs to a new stage of coordinated development of the industrial chain. The deep collaboration among various links such as platforms, payloads, data, and applications is becoming an important driving force for the industrial scale development.

This strategic cooperation is an important step for Yunyao Aerospace to continuously promote the construction of global meteorological monitoring capabilities and SAR capability layout. In the future, both parties will continue to carry out in-depth cooperation around satellite technological innovation, constellation construction, and industrial collaboration, actively serving the commercial aerospace development needs of the "15th Five-Year Plan" period of the country, promoting the continuous progress of domestic commercial satellite technology, accelerating the large-scale construction of commercial SAR satellites and global meteorological monitoring satellites, providing more abundant and efficient space information services for fields such as new energy, navigation, and low-altitude economy, and helping to promote the high-quality development of China's commercial aerospace industry.

信念如炬，初心筑梦航天。作为深耕空间气象探测领域的党员科技工作者，李峰辉始终以党的创新理论凝心铸魂，深耕航天报国事业。求学期间，他便锚定国家空间信息安全战略需求，立志深耕气象卫星自主研发领域。2019年，他扎根滨海新区创办云遥宇航，毅然投身商业航天自主创新赛道。创业初期，面对技术差距、产业链薄弱等重重难题，他传承老一辈科研工作者自力更生、攻坚克难的奋斗精神，带领团队千次攻坚、反复迭代，成功突破掩星探测技术瓶颈，更颠覆性降低小卫星量产成本，现已带领公司成功发射47颗商业气象小卫星，用实干实绩诠释党员知重负重、锐意进取的奋斗本色。

On the occasion of celebrating the 105th anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China, the "Two Outstanding and One Model" awarding ceremony of Tianjin was held. Li Fenghui, the secretary, chairman and founder of Yunyao Aerospace Party Branch, was awarded the title of Outstanding Communist Party Member of Tianjin. Through aerospace scientific and technological innovation and practical achievements, his dedication and heroic spirit as a new era Communist Party member was demonstrated.

![](/media/news/ryjxImg36_260702134340A334.webp)

![](/media/news/ryjxImg37_260702134352A335.webp)

This commendation aims to promote positive energy and gather the momentum for progress, inspiring all the Party members across the city to firmly uphold their ideals and beliefs and be courageous in taking on responsibilities. Li Fenghui's being awarded as an advanced individual this time is not only a high recognition from the municipal committee and the Party organizations at all levels of the new district for his unwavering beliefs and loyalty to the Party, but also a full endorsement of Yun Yao Aerospace's long-term commitment to leading scientific and technological innovation through Party building, its deep engagement in the commercial aerospace field, and its dedication to serving national strategies. 

Belief is like a torch, and the original aspiration builds dreams for space exploration. As a Party member scientific researcher specializing in space meteorological detection, Li Fenghui has always focused on the Party's innovative theories to unite and strengthen his resolve, and has devoted himself to the cause of serving the country through aerospace. During his studies, he set his sights on the strategic needs of national space information security and was determined to delve deeply into the field of independently developing meteorological satellites. In 2019, he settled down in the Binhai New Area to establish Yunyao Aerospace and resolutely entered the independent innovation track of commercial aerospace. In the early stages of entrepreneurship, facing numerous difficulties such as technological gaps and weak industrial chains, he inherited the self-reliance and overcoming difficulties spirit of the older generation of scientific researchers, led the team to make thousands of attempts and iterative improvements, successfully breaking through the technical bottleneck of occultation detection, and more significantly reducing the production cost of small satellites. Now, he has led the company to successfully launch 47 commercial meteorological small satellites, using practical achievements to interpret the hardworking and enterprising spirit of Party members who bear heavy responsibilities and strive forward.

![](/media/news/ryjxImg38_260702134503A336.webp)

Party building leads and gathers strength, red energy empowers scientific innovation. While deeply focusing on the development of the enterprise, Li Fenghui has always adhered to the leadership of Party building for the high-quality development of the enterprise. He established the enterprise's Party branch, improved the mechanism for cultivating Party members, and practiced the concept of "cultivating key personnel into Party members and forging Party members into pioneers". Currently, more than half of the core positions in the company are held by Party members and pioneers. The Red Flag Party Member Vanguard Team, formed by them, is rooted in the research and development frontline, taking the lead in tackling key tasks and overcoming technical difficulties. They fully exert the role of the Party branch as a combat fortress, converting the red political advantages into the core driving force for the enterprise's innovation and development. 

This honor is not only a recognition but also a driving force for us to move forward. In the future, all the Party members of Yunyao Aerospace will take the advanced role models as role models, firmly support the "two affirmations" and resolutely implement the "two upholds", always maintain the clean and honest, diligent and responsible nature of Party members, continuously deepen the commercial aerospace field, tackle core technologies, improve the industrial layout, empower the high-quality development of Tianjin with independent innovation, and continue to strive and achieve new accomplishments for China's aerospace power and the high-level self-reliance and self-strengthening of the meteorological cause!
云遥星座主力卫星，搭载 GNSS 掩星、GNSS-R 反射等多型探测载荷，在轨稳定运行。
云遥气象卫星是云遥星座的主力星型，单星搭载 GNSS 掩星探测系统、GNSS-R 反射探测系统等多型气象载荷，可同时获取大气层、电离层与地表反射观测数据。截至目前公司已成功发射 47 颗商业掩星气象卫星，构成国内最大的商业掩星气象星座，规划总规模 90 颗，实现全球气象数据的高时空分辨率覆盖。

The workhorse satellite of the Yunyao constellation, carrying GNSS radio occultation, GNSS-R reflectometry and other payloads, operating stably in orbit.

The Yunyao meteorological satellite is the primary satellite model of the Yunyao constellation. Each satellite carries a GNSS radio occultation system, a GNSS-R reflectometry system and other meteorological payloads, simultaneously acquiring atmospheric, ionospheric and surface reflection observations. To date 47 commercial occultation satellites have been launched — the largest commercial occultation constellation in China — with a planned total of 90 satellites for global high-resolution coverage.
Largest commercial RO constellation in China
捕获斜穿大气层、电离层的低仰角 GNSS 信号，实现大气层、电离层和降雨的三维探测。

GNSS掩星探测系统（GNROI）由掩星探测接收机、掩星天线和定位天线组成，捕获斜穿大气层、电离层的低仰角 GNSS 导航信号，获取全球范围内大气掩星和电离层掩星观测信息，实现对大气层、电离层和降雨的三维探测，提升数值天气预报系统的预报精度。

核心指标：大气跟踪深度小于 1km；大气廓线数 ≥1500 条/天；电离层廓线数 ≥700 条/天；降雨强度反演精度 2mm/h（双极化）；极化相位差精度 ≤1.5°（双极化）；双机冷备。
全球大气层 / 电离层观测
降雨监测及数值天气预报
双极化掩星，实现降雨强度探测
Captures low-elevation GNSS signals traversing the atmosphere and ionosphere, enabling 3D sounding of the atmosphere, ionosphere and precipitation.

The GNSS radio occultation system (GNROI) consists of an occultation receiver, occultation antennas and positioning antennas. It captures low-elevation GNSS navigation signals traversing the atmosphere and ionosphere to obtain global atmospheric and ionospheric occultation observations, enabling 3D sounding of the atmosphere, ionosphere and precipitation and improving numerical weather prediction accuracy.

Key specs: atmospheric tracking depth below 1 km; ≥1500 atmospheric profiles/day; ≥700 ionospheric profiles/day; rainfall retrieval accuracy 2 mm/h (dual-polarization); polarization phase difference accuracy ≤1.5°; cold-standby dual redundancy.
接收经海洋及地表反射的 GNSS 信号，测量海面风场、土壤湿度、海冰覆盖与积雪深度。

GNSS-R反射探测系统由反射探测接收机、反射天线和定位天线组成，接收经过海洋及地表反射的 GNSS 信号，利用 GNSS 信号在地球表面不同下垫面区域的反射特性，实现海面风场、土壤湿度、海冰覆盖性和密集度、积雪深度等的测量。

核心指标：码片搜索范围 -6~2 个码片可调；码相关距可配置 1/2、1/4、1/8、1/16、1/32 码片。
Receives GNSS signals reflected from oceans and land to measure sea-surface wind, soil moisture, sea-ice coverage and snow depth.

The GNSS-R reflectometry system consists of a reflectometry receiver, reflection antennas and positioning antennas. By receiving GNSS signals reflected from the ocean and land surface and exploiting their reflection characteristics over different surface types, it measures sea-surface wind fields, soil moisture, sea-ice coverage and density, and snow depth.

Key specs: adjustable code-chip search range of -6 to +2 chips; configurable correlation spacing of 1/2, 1/4, 1/8, 1/16 and 1/32 chip.
同时接收定位、掩星（GNSS-RO）与反射（GNSS-R）信号，一套系统完成气象海洋环境同步观测。

GNSS一体化气象探测系统由一体化接收机、掩星天线、反射天线和定位天线组成，同时接收高仰角 GNSS 导航信号、斜穿大气层和电离层的低仰角信号（GNSS-RO）及经过地表反射的信号（GNSS-R），为卫星平台提供导航定位定姿服务的同时，完成大气层、电离层和海洋环境的同步观测。

核心指标：中性大气观测视场近地面~60km；电离层观测视场 60km~轨道高度；观测幅宽优于 1400km；具备实时观测、原始数据存储和待机三种工作模式。
星载卫星导航定位、定姿
大气层、电离层和海洋环境同步观测
Simultaneously receives positioning, occultation (GNSS-RO) and reflection (GNSS-R) signals — one system for synchronized meteorological and ocean observation.

The integrated GNSS meteorological sounding system consists of an integrated receiver plus occultation, reflection and positioning antennas. It simultaneously receives high-elevation GNSS navigation signals, low-elevation occultation signals (GNSS-RO) and surface-reflected signals (GNSS-R), providing navigation and attitude services for the satellite platform while synchronously observing the atmosphere, ionosphere and ocean environment.

Key specs: neutral atmosphere field of view from near-surface to 60 km; ionospheric field of view from 60 km to orbital altitude; swath better than 1400 km; real-time observation, raw-data storage and standby operating modes.
Low power, light weight, high reliability
